# FDG8099

> DO NOT overload one of the equality operators and not the other.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 8.13 Equality Operators.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test warning
- Status: draft

The C# compiler requires operator != together with operator == and the reverse (error CS0216), so C# code cannot break this rule. CA2226 (symmetrical operator overloads) is not mapped for the same reason.

## From the book

It is very surprising to developers when they discover that a type overloads just one of the operators.
